The '''Ziost Analysis Services Center''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. During the [[Galactic War]] it was operated by the [[Galactic Solutions Industries]], whose employees performed research on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]] in [[3636 BBY]] the station also served as a hub for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces. When [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] wiped out all life on Ziost, those aboard the station survived and watched the destruction unfold.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
GSI Orbital Station was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.<ref name="SWTOR" />
